Every major money table now reads row by row with its label attached to its numbers: the balance sheet (p28), the FY2019 receipts (p30), the five-page general fund appropriations schedule with its GRAND TOTAL of $41,178,985.82 appropriated against $40,057,293.56 spent (p32-36), the five-page special revenue funds schedule with its 175 named grants, gifts, revolving and enterprise funds (p37-41), the capital projects fund with its Grand Total of $8,493,845.14 (p42), all four assessors' tables including the five-year valuation and tax history (p43), the Treasurer's cash by bank account (p44), the trust and stabilization funds (p45-47), the five-year outstanding debt (p48), and the three-page receivables summary (p53-55). Outside the finance section the same is true of the elected and appointed officials lists, the cemetery interments, the Nashoba health service counts, the school accountability summary, the enrollment table, the MCAS tables, the Monty Tech AP series, the FY2020 capital plan in both its printings, the revolving fund authorisations, the FY2020 omnibus budget and the town election results. Three things are still NOT recovered and should not be claimed. A fourth limitation is not about rotation at all: the rendering hard-clips at 188 characters, which silently removes the rightmost column of the widest tables -- the entire third amount column and the SUMMARY OF RECEIPTS grand total on p30, the ENDING VALUE column of the trust funds on p45-47, and the ADJUSTMENTS and balance columns of the receivables summary on p53-55.
